title: Python Matplotlib
description: Matplotlib is a low level graph plotting library in python that serves as a visualization utility.
example:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
xpoints = np.array([0, 6])
ypoints = np.array([0, 250])
plt.plot(xpoints, ypoints)
plt.show()

challenges.title: Simple Plot
challenges.exercise: Import matplotlib.pyplot as plt. Plot a line from [0, 6] to [0, 100]. Use plt.show().
challenges.solution:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
x = np.array([0, 6])
y = np.array([0, 100])
plt.plot(x, y)
plt.show()
